cover_letter:
Dear Teamleader Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web Designer (Part-Time) position at Teamleader. As a designer with a technical edge and a passion for creating simple, bold, and human web experiences, I am drawn to your mission of simplifying work for European businesses. Your emphasis on a robust design system and a strong online visual identity resonates with my own approach to design: user-centered, consistent, and impactful.

With 2-4 years of professional experience in web design and development, I have honed my skills in creating responsive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing websites. At Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring that every page aligns with brand guidelines and delivers an intuitive user experience. My work on mirook.com, a multi-page site for a Belgian youth chess champion, demonstrates my ability to design from scratch, implement structured data, and optimize for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project also highlights my proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and my interest in HTML/CSS/JS, which facilitates direct collaboration with developers.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to establish and maintain a comprehensive design system at Teamleader. I understand the importance of consistency across all web pages and components, and I am skilled at translating complex ideas into engaging visuals. My experience with multilingual content (English, Turkish, and basic Dutch) and my AI-native mindset—using tools like ChatGPT for content variations and design exploration—align with your requirements.

Teamleader's lively, non-corporate culture and commitment to employee well-being are exactly the environment where I thrive. I am eager to bring my creativity, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail to your website team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Teamleader's online presence.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Web Design & UX/UI: responsive web design, user-centered design, brand identity, design systems, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva
- Web Development: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, HTML/CSS/JS (interest/knowledge)
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
